results.name: All 25 types appear in the dropdown before selecting a file; missing essentials are named
Each file has its own correct preview, replacement and permitted removal actions
Identity counts unique uploaded types; details-only, expired and rejected files do not mark requirements received
Actual platform completions remain in Training while uploaded training certificates have file controls
Office requests preselect the exact catalogue type and preserve their explanation
Type-specific fields hide irrelevant expiry/number inputs and show required qualification names
Large PDFs are rejected before sending; phone photos still pass through automatic resizing
Replacement locks the original type and sends the selected file ID without deleting history
Failed upload keeps the chosen file for retry; a successful retry is recorded once
A successful upload with a failed refresh tells the user it was saved and clears the file input
Leaving Credentials or changing accounts while preparing a file prevents upload
Remove is confirmed and targets only the chosen file; verified removal requests identify the exact evidence
Late document responses do not overwrite another page; failed reads offer retry
